plain: A sign or warning of what is to come; or to foretell it

webster.text: Something which foreshows a future event; a prognostic; a present fact indicating something to come.

example.quote: Its entrance into life is marked with the presage of its fate; and until this is remedied, it is in vain to punish.
example.cite: Thomas Paine, Rights of Man, Parts One and Two (London, 1791-92)
